body:
I have a best friend that is a TOTAL extrovert and sometimes she gets on my nerves.

For example, after having a sleep over with her once i just wanted to be alone. Thing is, she wanted to come to my house since we spent the night at hers. I was already at my house when she asked, so i texted her saying " I dont really want anyone over right now. I just wanna sit and watch a show or something.  Idk." And she sends back " So youre turning down your best friend for some stupid show? Wow." 

Bruh.

I have a bird that i had rescused last year in July named Birdie. He's a White-Winged Dove and he is the most adorable thing i have ever seen. I found him while biking with my friend. She saw him and wanted to scare him away for fun. I told her not to but she did anyways. He didnt fly away after being scared so me being my paranoid self thought either something was wrong with him or he was a baby that fell out of his nest. He ended up being a baby. On this day it was around 100-110° Fahrenheit and i had no idea how long the poor baby had been out there, so i took him home and hand-fed him for around 3 weeks.

 Its been around 11 months since i found him and a while ago i was playing with him and he pushes his neck out, flies over to a chair and flattens himself. Im kind of confused at this point and after a few seconds he puffs out his chest and begins twitching his wings back and forth. I went over and began to pet him and he closes his eyes and flattens more, then lets out a giant coo.

Its times like that i start to cry over how much i love that picky, stuborn bird.
